input.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
input.rationale: Section 9 caps liability mutually ("either party") and carves out Section 8 (indemnification), so mutuality and the indemnity carve-out are already met. However it fails the fallback on two material terms: (i) the cap is not 12 months' fees but only the fees paid for "the transaction which the liability relates to" in that period, which can be a small fraction of 12 months' fees and risks falling below the walk-away floor; and (ii) there are no carve-outs for breach of confidentiality (Section 10), gross negligence or willful misconduct — nothing elsewhere in the document supplies them. We therefore target the fallback with the shortest edit: delete the per-transaction narrowing and add the three missing carve-outs to the existing exception opener, leaving the rest of Section 9 (including the mutual consequential-damages waiver) untouched. Preferred items not pursued at this level (USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", data protection/security, fraud, IP infringement, payment-obligation exclusion) are noted only as upside.
